answer: Problem: sybil farms mint cheap IDs that flood grading seats near epoch close. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 0.8 POA velvet bond, then clears a dawn window — three copper-tagged attest receipts from distinct established peers within 90 minutes, each covering a different parent tip. Cost: N clones burn N×0.8 POA plus N×3 scarce peer favors. Verify: peers match bond height, peer uniqueness, and tip diversity on-ledger. Failure: recycled peers or tips under 2 heights slash 40% of the bond and lock the address one epoch.
